description.value: Fruiticana is a BC- and Alberta-based grocery chain specializing in fresh produce and South Asian pantry staples, including their own Indican spice and ingredient brand. The chain emphasizes a farm-to-table philosophy and carries a broad range of ethnic grocery products suited to diverse communities. Touring cyclists in the Abbotsford area would find it a useful stop for fresh fruit, vegetables, and specialty ingredients.
